_how: Edit plan. name; audio = wav of the song; beatmap = from beatmap.py; source + shots = from shots.py; start/end = song seconds of the section to cut (on downbeats); drop = song second the beat drops (usually = start); fight/main/main_share = optional shot limits. rank.py fills in picks and roles; set slot_roles yourself to override the automatic roles. Worked example: Gojo vs Toji round 2 on a 130 BPM trap song.
